subject.title: feat: persist Regular and Sale as Commerce-owned Money

question: Should absent price rows immediately deactivate existing catalog products, or should legacy availability remain until price data is explicitly migrated or opted in?
rationale: The new collection contains no price rows for existing products, while the required Regular value cannot be inferred safely; choosing either availability behavior changes the Commerce product contract.

options.title: Stage the price gate
options.body: Keep legacy products available until an explicit migration or approved rollout condition marks them price-managed.

options.title: Approve immediate de-listing
options.body: Accept that all catalog products without a Regular price become unavailable at upgrade and document the required operator remediation.

recommendation.title: Stage the price gate
recommendation.body: Keep legacy products available until an explicit migration or approved rollout condition marks them price-managed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed price and listability boundary and are the only evidenced participant connected to this new surface.
